# Drive fixtures (the Google Workspace and Gemini extension)

Extracted text from real files in Casey's Drive, captured read-only through the Drive MCP, one per format family, for `src/lib/gap/signals/drive-parsers.ts` and the sync. Each entry says the Drive id, the name, the mime type, the owner, the modified time and the extraction time apart, as the records do. No contact list and no receipt was taken (the recent CSV is a contact list with personal data; the recent PDFs include receipts): both are skipped by choice. The bodies are trimmed to the passages the tests need; the whole document is at the link. <!-- verified:2026-10-10 -->

## The folders the sync reads (confirmed read-only through the Drive MCP, 2026-10-10)

`DRIVE_DEFAULT_FOLDERS` in `src/lib/gap/signals/drive-client.ts` names these three roots. The names below are Drive's own data, copied exactly (the yard-audit root carries an em dash; the code writes it as `—`). The resolver compares names normalized (case-insensitive, any run of dashes or whitespace as one space), so `GAP_DRIVE_FOLDERS=YardFlow - Prospect Yard Audits` resolves to the same folder; an id in `GAP_DRIVE_FOLDERS` passes through unchanged. <!-- verified:2026-10-10 -->

| Root | Drive id | Parent | Owner | Created | What sits in it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Meet Recordings` | `1qJyRZM-t_rmUG2CS29t0kMkLQNB9LPfQ` | `1jPtEKAFC-NqDFQjLL-95XSb-T_dn0aDg` | casey@freightroll.com | 2025-11-19 | Meet recordings and the Notes by Gemini documents |
| `Gemini Artifacts` | `1YEX5pqW0_JQveqHJPUWcwAN-F8vlRtD8` | `0ALEjyVc4MhfnUk9PVA` (My Drive) | casey@freightroll.com | 2026-06-30 | Gemini outputs |
| `YardFlow — Prospect Yard Audits` | `1arpvfAFP2Gyj1PmVtPvPgrw7Z_XZ115P` | `0ALEjyVc4MhfnUk9PVA` (My Drive) | casey@freightroll.com | 2026-05-18 | one file at the root (`INTEL-MANIFEST`, a Doc, `1f2pJJtv1DoBB2RIYOvwjJvwECshvaXmixNZBBg-_Pi8`) and 39 subfolders |

The audit's earlier default, `Yard Audits`, named no folder in this Drive: the root above was never read. The sync now reads every configured root ONE level down (at most 50 subfolders per root, each with its own cursor, its name the account hint for its files). The 39 subfolders of the yard-audit root at capture (two listing pages, the second without a next token): 38 prospects (AB InBev, Barnes & Noble, Bob Evans Farms, Campbell's, Caterpillar, CJ Logistics America, Coca-Cola, Constellation Brands, Cost Plus World Market, Crowley `1LXlgUOGZaqBcVQEeu_fVKqH4yO-rYqXW`, Daimler Truck North America, Dannon `1HGIzRrb_y151atpWfxq3IhIJQrxe9vYG`, DHL Supply Chain, Diageo, FedEx, Ford, Frito-Lay, General Mills, Georgia-Pacific, GXO Logistics, H-E-B, Honda, Hormel Foods, JM Smucker, John Deere, Mondelez, Nestle USA, Niagra Bottling (spelled so in Drive), Pactiv Evergreen, Performance Food Group, Salson Logistics, SC Johnson, The Boston Beer Company, The Home Depot, Toyota, United Natural Foods, Universal Logistics, Westrock Coffee) and `Master Audits` (`1HLniN6xTqg8-yWDK1Vqhw5wASzAsopfo`, a scope, never an account hint). Most were created on 2026-05-18 or 2026-05-19, so their files predate the default first-run window (`GAP_DRIVE_FIRST_RUN_DAYS`, 120 days back from the first run); a first run that should read them needs that variable raised.

Two levels down is not read and is said as skipped ("a folder two levels down"): `Crowley` holds `dossiers` (`1Ebay0NK7Hip1ulzl-w_ABuwKOjrvi6JK`), `sites` (`1cNH9srlJY42LGaOhf9Sd4dDJjje6VZ0x`) and `vendor setup docs` (`1dsN4pXpCqPH7ZNiJos71wRkIDWzXCTS3`) beside its own files (`Crowley — Yard Audit`, a Sheet, `1cq1eiNA9xo6TZ8SgRFii5UqX0KpZey1bWancNNz4hgo`; `crowley-geofence-links.md`, `1wpm-pWlhiVRvyne7r7T90zjyPrej-I-9`). Named debt: the Crowley dossiers live two levels down; reading them needs that folder configured as a root of its own (its id in `GAP_DRIVE_FOLDERS`).
